sources.prompt: Spacecraft engine accelerating for takeoff: deep mechanical idle for one second, then a clearly audible rising turbine pitch and powerful warm propulsion roar, reaching full thrust at four seconds and sustaining to the end. Strong low-mid harmonics audible on laptop speakers, not just sub-bass or wind. Smooth cinematic motor, no harsh squeal, no clicks, no sparks, no music, no speech.

Spacecraft descent engine, nine seconds. Start with a clear warm turbine spool-up, build into controlled heavy thrust with recognizable mechanical low-mid harmonics, then pulse the retro thrusters twice during deceleration and wind down at the end. Engine should be identifiable on ordinary laptop speakers, not just bass or a wind wash. Smooth sound, no clicking, no beeps, no explosions, no music, no voices.
